card.name: Linking words before tests or imaging
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas (an, or, and, including) right before a diagnostic test or scan is named, such as MRI, x-ray or laboratory testing. It appears in sentences about work-up when a condition is suspected.

modes.label: Before an imaging study
modes.description: A comma, 'or' or 'an' just before a scan such as MRI or x-ray is named.
modes.example: the physician should promptly schedule a complete physical and neurological examination and should consider<< an>> MRI.

modes.label: Before lab or diagnostic testing
modes.description: 'and', 'including' or 'complete' just before testing or sampling is named.
modes.example: Prior to intrathecal injection, assess liver function by clinical examination<< and>> laboratory testing.

card.writes: It pushes the model to name tests and imaging (tests, MRI, scans) as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a test or scan is named in a work-up.
